summary: Thomas McMurray, 63, of Crestone, died while kayaking the Arkansas River alone; his body was pulled from the river by emergency responders near the Wellsville Bridge at U.S. 50 mile marker 227; authorities believed he had launched an inflatable kayak in the Salida area and was alone
location: Arkansas River near Wellsville Bridge, U.S. 50 mile marker 227
notes: Mountain Mail 2014 season roundup parent-opened this run; third accident, 'June 23'. Wellsville is in Fremont County (parent-verified via mindat.org).
